question: Does the published native full-equity DD deterioration persist after removing pre-2023 equity observations and resetting the running peak within the frozen 2023H1-2024H2 study window, and what balance/floating-exposure state explains any remaining difference?

trigger.problem: The published peak predates the frozen 2023H1-2024H2 research population and therefore cannot by itself establish an in-window S3 drawdown effect.

snapshot_contract.row_selection: row_type equals equity_snapshot, observation_utc is parseable UTC, and account_equity is finite
snapshot_contract.deduplication: hard fail on duplicate observation_utc within a population
snapshot_contract.running_peak_initialization: first valid equity snapshot inside each evaluated window
snapshot_contract.maximum_drawdown: maximum nonnegative drawdown within the evaluated window
snapshot_contract.tie_break: earliest trough; its running-peak source is the latest occurrence of the maximum peak available before that trough
snapshot_contract.recovery: first later in-window snapshot with equity greater than or equal to the peak equity; null when unrecovered before window end

mandatory_analyses: Reproduce the legacy unbounded DD from all available equity_snapshot rows for both native populations.
Compute pooled bounded DD with the running peak reset at the first 2023-2024 snapshot.
Compute independently reset DD for each of 2023H1, 2023H2, 2024H1 and 2024H2.
At every pooled and fold trough, report balance, equity, floating P/L proxy, margin, free margin, open counts and open lots.
At each population's pooled trough time, obtain the other population's latest snapshot at or before that time when the time gap is no more than 60 seconds; otherwise report no aligned comparison.
Reconstruct active ticket identities at each pooled trough from rows carrying ticket, open_utc and close_utc; summarize strategy, side and lots without estimating unavailable per-ticket floating P/L.
Report observation coverage, first/last timestamp, median interval, maximum interval and duplicate count for each population.
Separate balance-path contribution from floating-P/L contribution at the drawdown trough; do not infer causal per-ticket mark-to-market when it is not present in the ledger.

classification_rules.PASS_PREPERIOD_PEAK_CONTAMINATION_RESOLV: Legacy candidate DD is worse, but pooled 2023-2024 bounded candidate DD is less than or equal to bounded baseline DD.
classification_rules.FAIL_BOUNDED_NATIVE_EQUITY_DD_WORSE: Pooled 2023-2024 bounded candidate DD remains greater than bounded baseline DD.
classification_rules.TECHNICAL_STOP_INSUFFICIENT_NATIVE_EQUIT: Any immutable input, required column, equity_snapshot population, uniqueness or legacy-reproduction check fails.

next_decision: After immutable result archiving, Research must separately decide whether the fixed S3 candidate is eligible for a preregistered one-shot 2025 gate. No automatic 2025 dispatch is permitted.
